title: fix(service-automation): a currency hole refused after a failed tenant-settings read is a runtime failure, not a guard refusal
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DF8zq975FQQqJfYxnH4mVgp)_

domain:server#4 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4czcfiRnuFCuLdmegYt

Fixes #28056

Clause-②: no (a refusal that followed a failed read of the organization's default currency is now an ordinary runtime failure, which a `fault` edge routes; every run that succeeded still succeeds, and a refusal after a read that succeeded stays the guard refusal it was)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：flow 文本里 `{{ amount | currency }}` 缺租户默认币种时，若是因为读 `sys_setting` 失败（而不是组织真没设），现在判为普通运行时失败：fault 边能接住，`errorHandling: retry` 读恢复后就成功；报错说“设置读不出来”，不再叫人去设币种。
- 为什么改：自动化插件的币种解析器忽略 `readFailed`，运行准备又把拒绝和“没有”一样吞掉，于是一次瞬时读故障被当成 guard 拒绝（不可路由），原因还写错。messaging 通道在 #27257 已按同样规则分级。
- 风险与回滚：只在“本次读失败 + 用占位币种重渲染能成功”时改判；真没设币种、或模板别处本身有错，仍是原 guard 拒绝。无新错误码，不动 `packages/spec` 与 `AutomationContext`，读失败标记放在本包 WeakMap，不持久化。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/template.ts`（`gradeAfterTenantCurrencyReadFault`）、`src/dag-traversal.ts`（executeNode 的 throw 分支）、`src/run-resume.ts`（两处 catch）、`src/plugin.ts`（`readFailed` 时拒绝）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/builtin/notify-currency-read-fault.test.ts src/builtin/notify-currency-tenant-default.test.ts`，预期全绿：读失败被 fault 边接住、retry 后发出 CN¥ 标题；真没设币种仍不路由。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`FlowTenantCurrencyResolver` gives a rejection its own meaning: the read FAILED. `undefined` still means the read succeeded and found no default.

- **`plugin.ts`.** The automation plugin's tenant-currency resolver rejects when `resolveLocalizationContext` answers `readFailed` (#27257), as the messaging channels' `getTenantCurrency` does. It used to return `localization.currency` and drop `readFailed`.
- **`run-resume.ts`.** Run setup (`resolveRunContext`) and a resumed segment's re-read (`withTenantCurrency`) still leave `AutomationContext.currency` unset on a rejection, and now note the failed read beside that context (`noteTenantCurrencyReadFault`). The resumed segment notes a copy, so the persisted context never carries one segment's fault into a later resume. Nothing is added to `AutomationContext` (`packages/spec`) or the persisted run.
- **`builtin/template.ts`.** `gradeAfterTenantCurrencyReadFault(err, variables, context)`: a `FlowTextTemplateError` thrown for a context whose read failed is rendered once more with the placeholder currency `XXX` (ISO 4217's "no currency"). If that renders, the only refusal was the missing default, and a plain `Error` without the guard brand is returned, saying the `localization.currency` setting could not be read. If it still refuses, the guard refusal is returned as it stands. Any other failure, and every refusal after a successful read, is returned unchanged. Same probe as service-messaging's `templateRefusalAfterCurrencyReadFault` (#27257).
- **`dag-traversal.ts`.** `executeNode`'s throw arm grades the thrown failure first, so the failure step, `$error` and the `isGuardRefusal` routing decision all read the graded failure. This is the engine's existing classification (#3863): a non-guard failure is routable by a `fault` edge; `errorHandling.strategy: 'retry'` re-runs a failed run either way. No new code.
- **`engine.ts`.** The `FlowTenantCurrencyResolver` docblock states the rejection meaning.

The seam is shared by every text slot a node renders, so `http` and `screen` slots are graded the same way as `notify`.

## Why

A transient `sys_setting` read failure failed a `notify` run as a permanent guard refusal: a declared `fault` edge could not route it, and the error told the operator to set a default currency the organization may already have.

## Verification

Measured on `main` `5448585d` before the change (a scratch test, not committed): a `notify` flow with a `fault` edge, the resolver throwing:

| Case | Before | After |
|:--|:--|:--|
| read fails, `fault` edge declared | run `failed`; the edge is not taken; error "...the organization has none set... Set the default currency in Setup → Localization" | run completes through the `fault` edge; `$error.message` says the `localization.currency` setting could not be read |
| read fails, `errorHandling: retry` (`maxRetries: 2`) | re-run (3 reads), every attempt refused | unchanged retry; the run succeeds on the attempt whose read succeeds |
| read succeeds, no default | guard refusal, not routed | unchanged |
| read succeeds, `CNY` | `Won CN¥1,234.50` | unchanged |

Pins, `src/builtin/notify-currency-read-fault.test.ts` (3 red on `main`, 10/10 green on this head):
- engine: a failed read is routed by the `fault` edge and `$error` names the failed read; retry succeeds once the read does; a successful read with no default keeps the guard refusal (not routed); a successful read with a default is unchanged.
- resume: a resumed segment whose read fails is routed by its `fault` edge, and the persisted context stays as it parked.
- unit: the probe regrades only a refusal a default would cure; with no failed read noted, every refusal is returned as it stands.
- plugin: booted over an ObjectQL whose `sys_setting` read throws, the refusal is routed; over one that finds no default, the guard refusal stands.

The existing `notify-currency-tenant-default.test.ts` row "refuses the node by name when the read fails" still holds (no `fault` edge there, so the run still fails, naming the hole and `localization.currency`).

Ablations (each restored through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, blob == HEAD after):
- A1 the throw arm does not grade → 3 red (engine, resume, plugin).
- A2 the plugin resolver ignores `readFailed` → 1 red (plugin).
- A3 the resumed segment does not note the failure → 1 red (resume).
- A4 no probe (always regrade) → 1 red (a refusal a default would not cure).
- A5 run setup does not note the failure → 2 red (engine, plugin).

Suites: `@objectstack/service-automation` full vitest 228 files / 2886 tests pass; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation typecheck` (incl. `check:test-typecheck`) passes. `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 62 families at head `e62036b8`: all exit 0 (`check:dual-build-cjs-loads` after the `dogfood^...` + `runtime^...` dist build), `--ran` reconcile 62/62, 0 NOT MEASURED; `pnpm lint` exit 0. `main` merged at `549203d0`; nothing on `main` since touches `service-automation`.
